changes: Window fetch timing now handles mid-line WX/WY/LCDC/map changes at tile boundaries, reducing stale tiles and seams in masks, panels, and split-screen effects.
Mealybug DMG structural match rose from 86.6361% to 88.7153% (+2.0792 points); key window-register cases improved by up to 17.34 points.
Window-line state, fetch latches, and active transfer phase now restore consistently in save states, preventing a mismatched line after loading.
Fresh-process paired benchmarks improved all six audited cartridges by +1.60% to +4.42%, adding headroom for shaders, audio, input, and UI without changing the 59.7275 Hz emulated cadence.
Benchmark reports now include isolated-trial metadata; checksums match the prior core so performance numbers cannot hide skipped work or different execution.
The offline single-file build and the v2.1 audio, RTC, DMA, mapper, save, and input improvements remain intact; remaining accuracy gaps are documented in the full release notes.
